derived_from: outcome definition only (no Brain code or docs read)
brain_implements_note: every requirement's brain_implements is TO BE RECONCILED by the code investigator

elements.name: Objective fidelity
elements.definition: Restates the objective exactly: metric (collected, settled cash unless the owner said otherwise), amount, window with real dates, capital, owner-involvement limit and every owner-stated constraint; adds no restriction the owner did not state (any system policy that limits the plan is disclosed as such); discloses interpretations of ambiguities.

elements.name: One selected strategy, fully specified
elements.definition: What is sold, to which real buyer segment, at what price, through which acquisition channel, fulfilled how and by whom, paid by which mechanism on which terms.

elements.name: Arithmetic that reaches the target
elements.definition: Unit economics with all material costs (fees, COGS, shipping, taxes, refunds, acquisition), a volume/funnel model from daily actions to collected cash with capacity limits, reaching the target in the expected case with a stated, derived confidence; every number internally consistent and recomputable.

elements.name: Cash feasibility
elements.definition: A dated cash-flow schedule in which the balance never drops below zero given the stated capital, including prepayments, holds, reserves and settlement lags; peak capital need stated.

elements.name: Time feasibility
elements.definition: A critical path with real dates covering every prerequisite (accounts, approvals, warm-up, supplier lead time, buyer cycle, delivery, settlement) such that enough cash is collected before the window ends, with slack stated.

elements.name: Owner feasibility
elements.definition: Owner hours per week within the stated limit; every capability, licence, account or credential required is either held by the owner (per a record) or acquired by a planned step within budget and window.

elements.name: Lawful and terms-compliant
elements.definition: No step breaks law in the relevant jurisdictions or a platform's terms (outreach, consumer protection, licensing, tax, data protection, marketplace and ad rules).

elements.name: Evidence and assumptions
elements.definition: Every material figure traces to cited, applicable evidence, an owner input, or an explicit assumption; decisive assumptions are named with ranges and each has an early test.

elements.name: Executable steps and a named first action
elements.definition: Ordered steps with actor, inputs, duration, dependencies, cost and done criteria; a first action that can start immediately with no unmet prerequisites.

elements.name: Checkpoints, kill criteria and fallback
elements.definition: Dated leading indicators with thresholds and the response if missed, protecting remaining capital; a fallback where one is feasible.

elements.name: Money commitments and approval
elements.definition: Each spend listed with amount, timing, reversibility and the approval it needs; total and peak within capital; no spend executes without owner approval.

elements.name: Alternatives and honest confidence
elements.definition: Briefly states the strategies considered and why they lost; states confidence and open unknowns without overclaiming.

usable_plan_definition.rule: USABLE = U01..U12 all satisfied AND zero critical mistakes (Q-CM01..Q-CM20). A plan with any critical mistake is not USABLE regardless of quality elsewhere.

stages.name: Market actors (buyers, suppliers, competitors, channels, fulfilment)
Acquisition, payment, timing, operational and legal constraints

requirements.title: Structured objective specification
requirements.accomplish: Turn the owner's free-text objective into a structured, versioned specification: target metric, amount, currency, window (start event, end date, timezone), capital available, owner-involvement limit, and every other stated condition, keeping the verbatim source span for each field.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every field cites a span of the owner's text or is marked UNSTATED; no field holds a value the text does not support; re-parsing the same text yields the same spec; a grader comparing spec to text finds no added or dropped condition.
failure_modes: model paraphrases '$10k revenue' as profit or bookings
window start assumed instead of read (creation vs approval)
capital read as spendable budget when owner meant total exposure
silent default fills an UNSTATED field
requirements.recovery: Re-parse with a validator that diffs fields against spans; unresolved fields become explicit interpretation decisions (Q-R002/Q-R005), never silent defaults.
requirements.observability: Replay objective texts through intake; diff spec fields against verbatim spans; count fields with no span.

requirements.title: Target-metric semantics
requirements.accomplish: Decide precisely what counts toward the target: collected (settled, available) cash versus invoiced, booked, GMV, or profit; gross versus net of refunds; whether pass-through money (resold goods at cost) counts; whether returning the capital matters.
outputs: metric definition with recognition rule and the alternative interpretations rejected
requirements.correct_behaviour: A written recognition rule exists (e.g. 'counts when funds are in the owner's account and not reversible within normal chargeback risk'), is applied identically by economics, timeline and plan, and any reading other than the literal one is shown to the owner in the plan.
failure_modes: different faculties use different metric definitions
requirements.recovery: Recompute economics and timeline against the single recognition rule; flag plan sections using another definition.
requirements.observability: Inspect metric definition record; check each plan figure labelled toward target uses its recognition rule.

requirements.title: Owner capability and asset profile
requirements.accomplish: Capture what the owner has and can do: skills, licences, legal entity, jurisdiction, payment/merchant accounts, audiences, domains, inventory, tools, network, hours available, risk tolerance — each as known, unknown, or absent.
outputs: owner profile with per-item status and source
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every capability a plan later relies on has status KNOWN-HELD with a source (owner statement or verified record); unknowns stay UNKNOWN and are never read as held.
failure_modes: assuming the owner has a Stripe account, an LLC, a sales skill or an audience
stale profile after owner's situation changed
requirements.recovery: Treat unknown as absent for planning, or add an acquisition step, or ask (if decisive, Q-R005).
requirements.observability: For each plan step, list required capabilities and check each against profile status and source.

requirements.title: Constraint provenance: owner constraint vs system policy
requirements.accomplish: Tag every constraint with its origin: OWNER-STATED, LEGAL/PLATFORM-RULE, SYSTEM-POLICY (e.g. a default exclusion or a cost cap), or SYSTEM-ASSUMPTION. Only owner-stated and legal constraints may narrow the strategy space for this goal; system policies may limit how the system works but must not appear as the owner's restriction and must not silently exclude strategies.
outputs: constraint register with provenance and scope (this goal only / global)
requirements.correct_behaviour: No strategy is excluded by a constraint whose provenance is not owner or law unless the exclusion is disclosed in the plan; a constraint from a previous goal does not bind this one; the plan's constraint list equals the owner-stated set plus disclosed legal ones.
failure_modes: system default ('no physical products', 'no industry X', 'email only') presented as owner restriction
owner's stated constraint dropped because a policy contradicts it
requirements.recovery: Re-run screening with only legitimate constraints; disclose any policy that still limits the plan.
requirements.observability: List screened-out strategies with reasons; check each reason's constraint provenance.

requirements.title: Ambiguity resolution with minimal owner involvement
requirements.accomplish: For each ambiguity decide whether it is decisive (changes strategy feasibility or selection). Non-decisive: adopt the conservative reading and record it. Decisive and unresolvable from records: ask the owner one batched, precise question, while continuing other work.
outputs: interpretation decisions; at most a small batched owner question set
requirements.correct_behaviour: Owner questions are only about decisive items unanswerable from records; each recorded interpretation is visible in the plan; work on non-dependent branches is not blocked by a pending question.
failure_modes: asking many trivial questions (violates minimal involvement)
stalling all work on one question
requirements.recovery: Fall back to conservative interpretation and a plan variant per answer if the owner does not reply within a bound.
requirements.observability: Count owner questions per goal and classify each as decisive or not; check plan discloses interpretations.

requirements.title: Objective feasibility pre-screen and honest infeasibility
requirements.accomplish: Estimate early, from order-of-magnitude reasoning, whether the objective is plausibly reachable, and at the end report infeasible (with the closest achievable variant) rather than fabricate a plan.
requirements.correct_behaviour: On infeasible control objectives the system reports infeasibility with reasons; on feasible ones the prior does not prematurely stop search.
failure_modes: forced plan for an impossible target
verdict based on one weak strategy
requirements.recovery: Continue discovery while the prior is uncertain; final verdict only after selection (Q-R062).
requirements.observability: Include infeasible controls in evaluation; inspect verdicts and reasons.

requirements.title: Jurisdiction and location determination
requirements.accomplish: Establish the owner's legal jurisdiction, tax residence and operating location (and buyers' locations) because law, payment rails, licences and tax depend on it; unknown is an answer that forces conservative choices.
outputs: jurisdiction record with source or UNKNOWN
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every legal, tax, payment or licence conclusion names the jurisdiction it assumed, and that jurisdiction comes from a record; none is assumed by default.
failure_modes: US law assumed for a non-US owner
buyer jurisdiction ignored (GDPR for EU recipients)
requirements.recovery: Ask if decisive; else restrict to strategies lawful in all plausible jurisdictions.
requirements.observability: Check each legal/payment finding for a jurisdiction field and its provenance.

requirements.title: One shared per-goal understanding
requirements.accomplish: Maintain a single authoritative, versioned goal model (objective spec, metric rule, owner profile, constraint register, environment facts, opportunity set, strategies, assumptions, evidence links, economics, critique findings, current selection) that every faculty reads from and writes to; no faculty reasons from a private copy or from conversational memory.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every faculty output records the goal-model version it read; at selection time all inputs to the decision reference the same version or a compatible later one; two faculties never hold conflicting values for the same fact without a conflict record.
failure_modes: faculties pass prose between each other and lose structure
economics uses a price the actor analysis revised
state only in a chat transcript
requirements.recovery: Rebuild derived views from the goal model; reject writes that bypass it.
requirements.observability: For a goal, collect every faculty output and compare the version and values of shared facts.

requirements.title: Change propagation and staleness
requirements.accomplish: When any fact, evidence item or assumption changes, mark every dependent computation (economics, rankings, plan sections) stale and recompute it before it is used.
requirements.correct_behaviour: No released plan contains a value derived from a superseded input; the dependency closure of a change is recomputed within the run.
failure_modes: plan keeps an old conversion rate after research refuted it
dependency links missing so staleness not detected
requirements.recovery: Full recompute of the goal's derived state from inputs before release.
requirements.observability: Mutate one input in a replay; check that every derived figure using it changes or is flagged.

requirements.title: Goal isolation and scoped knowledge reuse
requirements.accomplish: Keep each goal's owner-specific facts, constraints and evidence applicability separate; reuse only general market knowledge, explicitly scoped and re-checked for applicability.
requirements.correct_behaviour: No fact, constraint or figure in goal A's plan originates from goal B unless it is general knowledge marked as reused and applicability-checked; a plan always answers its own objective.
failure_modes: plan for the wrong objective after a worker picked up a mismatched item
requirements.recovery: Invalidate contaminated items and recompute.
requirements.observability: Trace each plan fact's origin goal id.

requirements.title: Assumption register
requirements.accomplish: Every non-evidenced belief used in reasoning is an explicit assumption with value/range, basis, sensitivity, status (untested/supported/refuted) and the decisions it affects.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every plan figure not tied to evidence or owner input ties to an assumption record; refuted assumptions are not used.
requirements.recovery: Extract implicit assumptions from plan text in critique (Q-R054) and register them.
requirements.observability: Count plan figures without evidence/owner/assumption linkage.

requirements.title: Durable, resumable reasoning state
requirements.accomplish: Persist every intermediate step so a crash, restart or worker loss resumes from the last checkpoint without losing completed work or duplicating effects.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Killing any worker mid-run and restarting yields the same final plan class (modulo model nondeterminism) with no duplicated research effects and no lost evidence.
failure_modes: resume re-runs completed research and doubles cost
requirements.recovery: Transactional checkpoints; idempotent step keys; restart from last committed step.
requirements.observability: Fault-injection replay: kill workers at random steps and compare outcomes.

requirements.title: Economic environment model
requirements.accomplish: Build a dated model of the relevant environment: markets and demand the owner can reach, seasonality and events inside the window, platform and channel landscape, available payment rails, prevailing prices and costs, and regulatory regime for the jurisdiction.
outputs: environment facts with evidence links and dates
requirements.correct_behaviour: Environment facts used in reasoning are evidenced and dated within a freshness bound appropriate to the fact; seasonality inside the window is considered.
failure_modes: model's training-era knowledge treated as current
holiday or seasonal effects inside window ignored
requirements.recovery: Refresh stale facts via research queue when they are decisive.
requirements.observability: Inspect environment facts for evidence and dates; check window calendar effects are listed.

requirements.title: Calendar and time arithmetic
requirements.accomplish: Compute against the real calendar: today's date, window end, business days, holidays, weekends, payout schedules, shipping days and lead times.
outputs: calendar model used by timeline and cash-flow
requirements.correct_behaviour: All dates in the plan are real calendar dates consistent with the window; durations computed in business days where the counterparty works business days.
failure_modes: 30 calendar days treated as 30 business days
requirements.recovery: Deterministic date computation; never model-generated dates.
requirements.observability: Recompute every plan date deterministically and diff.

requirements.title: Owner-advantage mapping
requirements.accomplish: Identify what the owner's assets, skills, relationships and location make unusually cheap or fast, to steer discovery toward strategies the owner can execute quickly.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Discovery candidates include ones exploiting listed advantages; advantages are only those with KNOWN-HELD status.
requirements.recovery: Re-seed discovery from advantages.
requirements.observability: Compare advantage list to candidate set.

requirements.title: Broad opportunity discovery without a fixed catalog
requirements.accomplish: Generate candidate opportunities across business-model classes (services, productized services, resale/arbitrage, brokering, digital products, local services, B2B, events, rentals, etc.) and industries, seeded by owner advantages and the environment, never limited to a predefined list.
outputs: opportunity candidate set with class labels and rationale
requirements.correct_behaviour: The candidate set spans several distinct business-model classes and industries; no industry or class is absent because of a system list; candidates for an objective unlike any seen before are still produced.
failure_modes: template overfit: same three strategies for every objective
catalog limited to what the system already 'knows how to do'
requirements.recovery: Diversity prompts across classes; add candidates from different reasoning directions (backward from target, from owner assets, from buyer pain, from arbitrage gaps).
requirements.observability: Measure class/industry diversity of candidates per goal; compare across unfamiliar objectives.

requirements.title: Conservative, revisitable hard-constraint screening
requirements.accomplish: Screen candidates against hard constraints (capital, window, involvement, capability, legality) with cheap estimates, recording a reason per rejection; rejected candidates are kept and revisited if evidence changes.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each rejection cites a constraint with legitimate provenance and an estimate; rejections based on an unknown are 'deferred', not 'rejected'; nothing is deleted.
failure_modes: good candidate rejected on a favourable-or-unfavourable guess
rejection reason is a system policy
candidates deleted so revision cannot recover them
requirements.recovery: Re-screen deferred candidates when unknowns resolve.
requirements.observability: Sample rejected candidates; check reason, constraint provenance, estimate.

requirements.title: Generalization to unfamiliar objectives
requirements.accomplish: Discovery, strategy and research must not depend on objective-specific templates; they work for objective types (amounts, windows, capitals, constraints, industries) absent from development data.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Performance on held-out objectives is not materially worse than on development objectives.
failure_modes: prompts tuned on the development set
requirements.recovery: Expand the reasoning procedure, not the template list.
requirements.observability: Compare usable rate on held-out vs development objectives.

requirements.title: Genuinely different strategies
requirements.accomplish: Develop at least three surviving strategies that differ in buyer, offer, channel, or monetization mechanism, not paraphrases of one idea.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Pairwise, strategies differ in at least one of buyer segment, offer, acquisition channel, or payment mechanism; a diversity metric is recorded.
requirements.recovery: Regenerate with explicit exclusion of existing strategies' defining attributes.
requirements.observability: Compute strategy-attribute overlap per goal.

requirements.title: Complete strategy specification
requirements.accomplish: Specify each strategy fully: offer, buyer segment, acquisition channel, price, fulfilment (who/how), payment mechanism and terms, cash timing, capital uses, owner tasks, required capabilities, key assumptions.
requirements.correct_behaviour: All schema fields populated or explicitly UNKNOWN (which spawns an unknown, Q-R023); no strategy reaches economics with an empty leg.
requirements.recovery: Complete the leg (Q-R022) or mark the strategy incomplete.
requirements.observability: Schema-validate strategy specs; count missing legs reaching economics.

requirements.title: Backward decomposition from the target
requirements.accomplish: For each strategy, reason backward: target collected revenue -> required transactions at price -> required conversions -> required leads/contacts -> required daily actions and capacity, inside the window and the settlement lag.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Decomposition arithmetic is deterministic and consistent with Q-R041; it states required daily volume and compares it to stated capacity.
failure_modes: forward-only storytelling with no volume math
ignores that last-week sales won't settle
requirements.recovery: Recompute in code; flag strategies whose required volume exceeds capacity.
requirements.observability: Replay decomposition numerically.

requirements.title: Completion of partial strategies
requirements.accomplish: A strategy with a missing or weak leg (e.g. no supplier, no channel) is completed by targeted search or combination with another strategy's leg, rather than silently passed or discarded.
outputs: completed specs or explicit abandonment with reason
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every incomplete strategy ends as completed, or abandoned with a recorded reason; none passes to selection incomplete.
failure_modes: good strategy dropped for a fixable gap
requirements.recovery: Spawn research for the missing leg.
requirements.observability: List strategies that changed completeness status and why.

requirements.title: Decisive-unknown identification
requirements.accomplish: For each strategy, determine which assumptions, across their plausible range, flip feasibility or ranking (sensitivity analysis), and mark them decisive.
outputs: decisive unknowns with the decision they affect
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each decisive unknown has a documented range and shows that the decision differs at range ends; non-decisive unknowns are not researched heavily.
failure_modes: researching trivia while the conversion rate is guessed
requirements.recovery: Run sensitivity in code over every assumption.
requirements.observability: Re-run sensitivity analysis; compare against the system's decisive list.

requirements.title: Research bounded by decision value
requirements.accomplish: Prioritize research questions by expected change in the decision per unit cost/time, allocate a per-goal research budget, and stop researching a question when its answer can no longer change the decision.
outputs: prioritized research queue entries with decision link and stop rule
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every research task names the decision it consumes and its expected value; research spend correlates with decision value; no task runs after its decision is settled.
failure_modes: fixed fragment counts regardless of gaps
requirements.recovery: Re-prioritize after each answer; cancel moot tasks.
requirements.observability: Inspect research tasks: decision link, value estimate, cancelled-after-moot count.

requirements.title: Answerable research questions
requirements.accomplish: Formulate each question specifically: the quantity, population, geography, time, acceptable source types and what answer would change the decision; examples in the question are not treated as boundaries.
requirements.correct_behaviour: A brief states quantity, unit, scope and acceptance criteria; an independent reader could tell whether an answer satisfies it.
failure_modes: brief over-narrowed to the example given
requirements.recovery: Rewrite brief after an unproductive round (Q-R033).
requirements.observability: Audit briefs against the schema.

requirements.title: Unknowns never resolved favourably by default
requirements.accomplish: An unanswered fact stays UNKNOWN; it cannot make a strategy feasible or rank it higher. Unresolvable decisive unknowns become early, cheap tests (experiments) in the plan with thresholds.
requirements.correct_behaviour: No ranking or feasibility verdict uses an optimistic value for an unknown without a disclosed assumption and a test step; the plan contains a test for each unresolved decisive unknown.
failure_modes: timeout on research read as 'no problem'
missing price data replaced with optimistic guess
an untested decisive assumption presented as fact
requirements.recovery: Use pessimistic bound in ranking; add test-and-checkpoint steps.
requirements.observability: For each decisive unknown, check its status, the value used in ranking, and the plan's test step.

requirements.title: Research queue execution
requirements.accomplish: Dispatch web search and page-reading tasks to asynchronous workers with leases, timeouts, retries, deduplication and result recording; failures are recorded as failures.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every queued task reaches a terminal state (answered, unanswerable, failed, cancelled) within a bound; no task is held by two workers; no failure is recorded as an empty success.
failure_modes: worker returns empty result marked complete
requirements.recovery: Lease expiry and reassign; mark unanswerable after bounded attempts.
requirements.observability: Queue audit: task ages, terminal states, empty-success count.

requirements.title: Source capture with provenance
requirements.accomplish: For each source: URL, retrieval time, retrieval state (read, paywalled, blocked, JS-only), content snapshot or hash, publisher and publication date.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every evidence claim links to a source record whose snapshot contains the cited passage; unreadable sources are recorded as unresolved, not inferred.
failure_modes: claim attributed to a page never read
page content changed after capture with no snapshot
requirements.recovery: Refetch or try official alternative sources.
requirements.observability: Sample claims; verify passage is present in stored snapshot.

requirements.title: Faithful evidence extraction
requirements.accomplish: Extract claims with quote, figure, unit, date, geography, segment and context from captured content; the extractor may not introduce numbers absent from the source.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every extracted number appears in (or is a documented transformation of) the cited passage; context fields populated.
requirements.recovery: Re-extract with entailment check; reject unsupported claims.
requirements.observability: Automated passage-number match and entailment check over claims.

requirements.title: Evidence verification and quality grading
requirements.accomplish: Grade each claim for entailment, source type (primary/secondary/anecdotal), credibility, recency and applicability to the strategy's buyer, geography and time; require independent corroboration for decisive figures.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Decisive figures used in selection have at least the required quality grade or are labelled assumptions; applicability mismatch is flagged.
failure_modes: marketing page claims taken as market data
requirements.recovery: Seek corroboration; downgrade to assumption.
requirements.observability: For each decisive figure, inspect grade and corroboration count.

requirements.title: Evidence conflict handling without overwrite
requirements.accomplish: When evidence conflicts, keep all items, record the conflict, and reconcile by applicability and quality with reasoning; new evidence never silently replaces old.
outputs: conflict records; reconciled value with range
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every conflict has a record and a resolution rationale; the value used is the reconciled one, with range reflected in uncertainty.
requirements.recovery: Reopen reconciliation when new evidence arrives.
requirements.observability: List conflicts and their resolutions; check figures used match resolution.

requirements.title: Reuse of existing evidence before new research
requirements.accomplish: Before dispatching research, query existing evidence and knowledge for applicable, fresh answers.
requirements.correct_behaviour: A brief whose answer exists at sufficient quality and freshness is not re-researched; reuse records applicability check.
failure_modes: paying twice for the same answer
requirements.recovery: Applicability check on reuse.
requirements.observability: Count duplicate research of answered questions.

requirements.title: Adaptive search strategy
requirements.accomplish: When searches return nothing usable, reformulate (synonyms, source types such as forums, marketplaces, government data, price lists, proxy measures) and record dead ends; never repeat an identical failing approach.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Consecutive attempts on one question differ in method; dead ends are recorded and consulted.
failure_modes: dead end read as negative answer
requirements.recovery: Escalate to reconstruction (Q-R034) or an in-plan test (Q-R026).
requirements.observability: Inspect attempt sequences per question.

requirements.title: Reconstruction of unpublished figures
requirements.accomplish: Where no source publishes a figure (e.g. a niche conversion rate), estimate it from mechanism and component evidence, labelled as an estimate with derivation chain and uncertainty.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each reconstruction lists components, their sources, the formula, and a range; it is never presented as a published figure.
requirements.recovery: Critique checks derivation; widen range.
requirements.observability: Audit reconstructed figures' derivation chains.

requirements.stage_name: Market actors (buyers, suppliers, competitors, channels, fulfilment)
requirements.title: Buyer existence, reachability and willingness to pay
requirements.accomplish: Establish that the buyer segment exists in sufficient number, can be reached through the chosen channel, pays the assumed price (evidence of comparable prices paid), and that its purchase cycle fits the window.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Buyer count, reachability path, price evidence and cycle length are each evidenced or labelled assumption; named buyers or examples are real and verifiable; cycle length + settlement fits the window.
failure_modes: enterprise buyer with 90-day procurement in a 30-day window
price evidence from a different segment
requirements.recovery: Re-target segment or downgrade strategy.
requirements.observability: Verify sampled named buyers exist; check cycle length vs window.

requirements.stage_name: Market actors (buyers, suppliers, competitors, channels, fulfilment)
requirements.title: Supplier and seller analysis
requirements.accomplish: For goods or subcontracted services: supplier exists, unit cost, MOQ, lead time, capacity, payment terms (prepay?), reliability, and whether the owner can open an account.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each supply input has an evidenced supplier with cost, MOQ, lead time and terms; MOQ x cost fits capital; lead time fits critical path.
failure_modes: wholesale account requires a resale certificate the owner lacks
requirements.recovery: Alternate supplier search; strategy downgrade.
requirements.observability: Check supplier records for evidence and terms.

requirements.stage_name: Market actors (buyers, suppliers, competitors, channels, fulfilment)
requirements.title: Competitor and alternative analysis
requirements.accomplish: Identify what buyers currently use instead, competitor prices and saturation, and why a buyer would choose this offer now.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Price assumption is positioned against evidenced competitor prices; a differentiation or channel reason exists.
failure_modes: price above market with no reason
requirements.recovery: Adjust price/positioning; re-run economics.
requirements.observability: Compare plan price to competitor evidence.

requirements.stage_name: Market actors (buyers, suppliers, competitors, channels, fulfilment)
requirements.title: Fulfilment analysis
requirements.accomplish: Determine how each unit is delivered, by whom, with what capacity per day, quality risk, refund/return exposure and owner hours.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Fulfilment capacity >= required volume from Q-R041; fulfilment cost included in unit economics; owner hours included in Q-R048.
failure_modes: selling more than can be delivered
fulfilment by the owner exceeds involvement limit
requirements.recovery: Add capacity (contractor) with cost, or reduce volume.
requirements.observability: Compare fulfilment capacity to required volume.

requirements.stage_name: Market actors (buyers, suppliers, competitors, channels, fulfilment)
requirements.title: Acquisition channel access and performance
requirements.accomplish: For the chosen channel: access prerequisites (accounts, approvals, domain warm-up, ad review, marketplace seller verification), time to usable, cost per lead/contact, conversion evidence and channel rules.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Channel prerequisites appear on the critical path with durations; cost and conversion are evidenced or assumptions with tests; channel rules feed Q-R050.
failure_modes: cold email at volume from a new domain on day 1
requirements.recovery: Add warm-up/prereq steps or switch channel.
requirements.observability: Check channel prerequisites and their durations in the timeline.

requirements.title: Unit economics with all material costs
requirements.accomplish: Compute contribution per unit: price minus COGS, payment processing, platform/marketplace fees, shipping, taxes/VAT where applicable, refunds/chargebacks, acquisition cost, fulfilment cost.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every cost category is present or explicitly zero with reason; each figure links to evidence/assumption; computed in code.
requirements.recovery: Add missing categories; recompute.
requirements.observability: Check presence of each cost category; recompute.

requirements.title: Volume and funnel model to collected revenue
requirements.accomplish: Model the funnel from daily actions to collected cash with capacity limits at each stage, producing the distribution of collected revenue inside the window.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Forecast counts only revenue meeting the recognition rule by window end; capacity constraints bind; computed deterministically.
failure_modes: sales in the last week counted though payout lands after window
requirements.recovery: Recompute with settlement cutoff.
requirements.observability: Recompute forecast; check last settlement date per sale cohort.

requirements.title: Cash-flow timeline and peak capital requirement
requirements.accomplish: Produce a dated cash in/out schedule including prepayments, fees, ad spend, inventory, reserves and settlement lags; compute peak capital need and minimum balance.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Balance never goes below zero with available capital; peak need <= stated capital (with a stated buffer); money committed before revenue arrives is accounted.
failure_modes: capital assumed recycled before payout arrives
reserve held by processor not modelled
requirements.recovery: Reduce scale, change terms, or reject strategy.
requirements.observability: Recompute daily balance series; find minimum.

requirements.title: Deterministic arithmetic verification
requirements.accomplish: All plan numbers are computed or re-computed by deterministic code from the structured model; model-written arithmetic is never trusted; mismatches block release.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every number in the plan equals the code-computed value (within rounding); any mismatch blocks release.
failure_modes: plan prose retypes a number differently
requirements.recovery: Regenerate plan figures from the structured model.
requirements.observability: Extract all numbers from the plan and diff against computed values.

requirements.title: Uncertainty and probability of reaching target
requirements.accomplish: Propagate ranges of decisive inputs to a distribution of collected revenue; report probability or confidence of reaching target, break-even volume, and most-sensitive inputs. Coverage of scenarios is not reported as probability.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Confidence is derived from stated ranges by a reproducible method; a point estimate is not presented as certainty; the most sensitive input matches sensitivity analysis.
requirements.recovery: Widen ranges; report lower confidence.
requirements.observability: Re-run uncertainty propagation; compare stated confidence.

requirements.title: Provenance for every plan figure
requirements.accomplish: Every number in the plan links to an evidence claim, an owner input, an assumption record, or a computation over these.
requirements.correct_behaviour: 100% of plan figures resolve to a provenance node; no orphan numbers.
requirements.recovery: Block release; resolve or label as assumption.
requirements.observability: Automated walk from plan numbers to provenance nodes; count orphans.

requirements.stage_name: Acquisition, payment, timing, operational and legal constraints
requirements.title: Payment acceptance and settlement feasibility
requirements.accomplish: Determine which payment methods the owner can actually use (by jurisdiction, entity, account status), account approval time, new-account holds and rolling reserves, payout schedule, invoice terms and chargeback windows, so that 'collected' cash lands inside the window.
requirements.correct_behaviour: For each strategy, the time from sale to available funds is evidenced and included in Q-R041/Q-R042; strategies relying on net-30+ terms or marketplace payout delays beyond the window are corrected or rejected.
failure_modes: new merchant account 7-14 day hold ignored
B2B invoices net-30 counted as collected
marketplace holds funds until delivery confirmation
requirements.recovery: Choose upfront payment / deposits / different rail; adjust forecast.
requirements.observability: For each strategy check sale->available-funds lag and its evidence.

requirements.stage_name: Acquisition, payment, timing, operational and legal constraints
requirements.title: Critical-path timing feasibility
requirements.accomplish: Build the critical path of all prerequisites (entity/account setup, supplier lead time, channel warm-up, content/product creation, shipping, buyer cycle, settlement) and check it fits the window with margin.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Earliest first-collected-cash date and the date by which enough volume settles are both before window end; slack is stated.
failure_modes: prerequisites in parallel that are actually sequential
requirements.recovery: Reorder, choose faster alternatives, or reject.
requirements.observability: Recompute critical path from step durations.

requirements.stage_name: Acquisition, payment, timing, operational and legal constraints
requirements.title: Owner-involvement budget
requirements.accomplish: Sum owner hours per week across all steps (including identity verification, signatures, calls, approvals, fulfilment) and keep within the stated limit; minimize owner-only tasks.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Owner hours in every week <= limit; every owner task is necessary (cannot be done by system or contractor) and named.
failure_modes: sales calls by owner every day under 'minimal involvement'
requirements.recovery: Delegate to system/contractor or reject strategy.
requirements.observability: Sum owner-assigned step hours by week.

requirements.stage_name: Acquisition, payment, timing, operational and legal constraints
requirements.title: Capability, licence and credential requirements
requirements.accomplish: List every capability, licence, permit, certification, account and credential each strategy needs; check each against the owner profile; either plan acquisition (with cost and time on the critical path) or reject.
requirements.correct_behaviour: No plan step requires something whose owner-profile status is not KNOWN-HELD unless an acquisition step precedes it and fits budget and window.
failure_modes: licensed activity (real estate, insurance, contracting, food) without licence
assumes owner has a business entity or bank account
needs a skill the owner lacks
requirements.recovery: Insert acquisition steps or reject.
requirements.observability: Cross-check required capabilities per step against owner profile.

requirements.stage_name: Acquisition, payment, timing, operational and legal constraints
requirements.title: Legal, regulatory and terms-of-service compliance
requirements.accomplish: Check every action against law in the relevant jurisdictions (outreach: CAN-SPAM, GDPR/PECR, TCPA; consumer protection; licensing; tax registration/collection; IP; data protection) and platform terms (marketplaces, ad platforms, email providers, scraping).
requirements.correct_behaviour: No step is unlawful or breaches a platform's terms; borderline steps are rewritten to a compliant form; findings cite the rule.
requirements.recovery: Rewrite step or reject strategy.
requirements.observability: Run each step through a compliance checklist; independent legal-style review on samples.

requirements.stage_name: Acquisition, payment, timing, operational and legal constraints
requirements.title: System's own executional capacity
requirements.accomplish: Determine which steps the system can actually perform (integrations, accounts, tools) vs which require the owner or a contractor, so plan assignment is real.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every step assigned to 'the system' maps to a capability the system has; otherwise it is reassigned.
failure_modes: plan says 'Brain will send 500 emails' with no sending integration
requirements.recovery: Reassign to owner (then check Q-R048) or contractor.
requirements.observability: Map system-assigned steps to integration inventory.

requirements.title: Independent adversarial critique
requirements.accomplish: Each finalist strategy and the draft plan are reviewed by a role or model that did not produce them, against the usable-plan definition and the critical-mistake taxonomy, producing structured findings with severity.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every critical-mistake category is checked explicitly; findings are structured (category, location, evidence); seeded-error plans are caught at a measured rate.
requirements.recovery: Route to a different model family or stronger model; repair via Q-R059.
requirements.observability: Inject known mistakes; measure catch rate; inspect finding records.

requirements.title: Internal contradiction detection
requirements.accomplish: Check consistency across plan sections, between plan and goal model, and between narrative and economics (same price, volume, dates, buyer everywhere; strategy described equals strategy computed).
requirements.correct_behaviour: Zero unresolved contradictions at release; check is mechanical where values are structured.
failure_modes: price $500 in one section, $300 in another
requirements.recovery: Regenerate sections from structured model.
requirements.observability: Automated cross-section value comparison.

requirements.title: Unsupported-assumption detection
requirements.accomplish: Find claims in plan text and reasoning that rest on neither evidence nor a registered assumption, and register or remove them.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every factual claim in the plan resolves to evidence or an assumption record.
requirements.recovery: Register as assumption with test step, or delete.
requirements.observability: Claim extraction over plan text and linkage check.

requirements.title: Objective and constraint conformance check
requirements.accomplish: Check the plan against the objective spec: right metric, amount, window, capital, involvement limit, every owner constraint satisfied, and no restriction the owner never stated.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each spec field satisfied; plan's stated constraints == owner-stated + disclosed legal/policy.
failure_modes: plan optimizes profit instead of collected revenue
adds 'no paid ads' restriction never stated
requirements.recovery: Repair or reselect.
requirements.observability: Diff plan constraints with spec.

requirements.title: Model-output validation
requirements.accomplish: Every model answer is validated before it becomes state: non-empty, schema-valid, not truncated, not a refusal, references real ids, answers this goal's question, numbers parseable; invalid outputs are recorded as failures and retried or escalated, never stored as results.
requirements.correct_behaviour: No empty, truncated, schema-invalid, or off-goal output appears in the goal model; failure rate per model is recorded.
failure_modes: refusal text parsed as a strategy
requirements.recovery: Retry with repair prompt, then another model, then mark the step failed and visible.
requirements.observability: Inject empty/truncated/invalid responses; verify none enters state.

requirements.title: Critic calibration
requirements.accomplish: Measure the critic's false-negative and false-positive rates on plans with seeded critical mistakes and on known-good plans; adjust or escalate where it misses categories.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Per-category recall is measured and meets a set threshold on the frozen revision.
failure_modes: critic never tested so misses are invisible
requirements.recovery: Add category-specific checks; escalate model.
requirements.observability: Inspect calibration results.

requirements.title: Evidence-triggered revision
requirements.accomplish: When evidence or critique refutes or changes an assumption, recompute the affected strategy, economics and ranking; the selection may change; revision recorded with cause.
requirements.correct_behaviour: After a refuting input, every affected decision is re-evaluated and the log shows before/after; the system will change its selected strategy when warranted.
failure_modes: new evidence attached but not used
requirements.recovery: Force re-evaluation of dependents.
requirements.observability: Inject a refuting evidence item in replay; check selection/economics respond.

requirements.title: Planned repair, not blind retry
requirements.accomplish: A failed check produces a targeted repair that addresses its cause and differs from previous attempts; attempts are bounded; after the bound, abandon the strategy or report blocked.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Consecutive repairs differ in method; attempt count bounded; failures preserved in history.
requirements.recovery: Escalate model; abandon strategy; choose runner-up.
requirements.observability: Inspect attempt sequences for difference and bound.

requirements.title: Convergence and termination
requirements.accomplish: The goal reasoning loop terminates with a selected plan, an infeasible verdict, or a named blocker within time and cost budgets; stalls are detected.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every goal reaches a terminal outcome within its budget; stall detector fires on no-progress intervals.
failure_modes: waiting forever on one research task
requirements.recovery: Decide with current evidence and disclose unknowns.
requirements.observability: Measure time-to-terminal and stall events per goal.

requirements.title: Comparison on a common basis
requirements.accomplish: Compare strategies on the same criteria computed the same way from the same goal-model version: probability of reaching target in window, capital at risk, owner hours, evidence strength, downside, time to first cash.
requirements.correct_behaviour: All strategies scored with identical criteria and evidence vintage; scores reproducible from inputs.
failure_modes: strategy A scored with old evidence, B with new
requirements.recovery: Recompute all scores together.
requirements.observability: Recompute comparison; check versions.

requirements.title: Single arbiter for competing proposals
requirements.accomplish: One decision authority resolves competing proposals from faculties, models and critics into one selected strategy, recording alternatives, reasons and dissent.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Exactly one selected strategy per goal version; decision record lists alternatives and why rejected; no faculty overrides it outside the arbiter.
requirements.recovery: Re-run arbitration on current version.
requirements.observability: Count selection records per goal version; inspect rationale.

requirements.title: Defensible selection rationale
requirements.accomplish: The selected strategy's rationale cites evidence and computed figures, survives critique, and explains why runners-up lost.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Rationale claims all resolve to provenance; no unresolved critical finding against the selection.
requirements.recovery: Regenerate rationale from structured comparison.
requirements.observability: Check rationale provenance.

requirements.title: Model routing, escalation and independence
requirements.accomplish: Use cheap models by default and escalate to stronger models on low confidence, disagreement, decisive steps, or repeated validation failure; agreement among correlated models is not treated as independent evidence.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Decisive judgements (selection, critique of finalist, legal check) are made or confirmed by a model of sufficient measured quality; escalation events recorded.
failure_modes: cheap model makes the final decision unchecked
ensemble of identical models counted as consensus
requirements.recovery: Escalate; use different model family for critique.
requirements.observability: Inspect model used per decisive step and measured quality.

requirements.title: Fallback strategy
requirements.accomplish: Retain a runner-up strategy compatible with remaining capital and time, triggered at a checkpoint if leading indicators fail.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Fallback has its own feasibility from the trigger date with remaining capital.
failure_modes: fallback infeasible after primary spends capital
requirements.recovery: Recompute fallback from trigger state.
requirements.observability: Check fallback economics from trigger date.

requirements.title: Executable step plan
requirements.accomplish: Convert the selected strategy into ordered steps, each with actor (system/owner/contractor), inputs, outputs, duration, dependencies, cost, and done criteria.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every step has all fields; dependencies acyclic; steps cover every leg of the strategy; sequencing matches critical path.
requirements.recovery: Regenerate steps from structured strategy and critical path.
requirements.observability: Schema and coverage check on steps.

requirements.title: Named first action
requirements.accomplish: Name the first concrete action, its actor, and how to do it, executable immediately with no unmet prerequisites and no money commitment that lacks approval.
requirements.correct_behaviour: First action has no unmet dependencies, is specific (what, where, who), and can start today.
failure_modes: first action depends on an account not yet opened
requirements.recovery: Select earliest dependency-free step; split it if vague.
requirements.observability: Check first action's dependencies and specificity.

requirements.title: Checkpoints and kill criteria
requirements.accomplish: Define dated leading indicators (replies, conversions, first payment settled) with thresholds and the response if missed (pivot, fallback, stop) to protect capital.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each decisive unknown has a checkpoint testing it early; thresholds derive from the funnel model.
failure_modes: no early test; failure discovered at day 30
requirements.recovery: Add checkpoint per decisive unknown.
requirements.observability: Map decisive unknowns to checkpoints.

requirements.title: Money-commitment schedule
requirements.accomplish: List each spend with amount, date, reversibility and approval requirement; total and peak within capital.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Sum and peak <= capital; each irreversible spend flagged for approval.
requirements.recovery: Recompute from cash-flow.
requirements.observability: Sum commitments; compare with capital.

requirements.title: Plan rendering from the structured model
requirements.accomplish: Render the human-readable plan from the structured goal model (numbers, dates, names injected, not retyped by a model), covering every usable-plan element, including alternatives considered, risks, assumptions and confidence.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every number and date in the document is injected from structured fields; all usable-plan sections present.
requirements.recovery: Re-render; validate (Q-R071).
requirements.observability: Diff rendered values with structured model.

requirements.title: Deterministic usable-plan completeness validator
requirements.accomplish: Before release, a deterministic validator checks presence and internal validity of every usable-plan element and blocks release on failure.
requirements.correct_behaviour: No released plan lacks a usable-plan element; failing plans are repaired or the goal reports blocked.
failure_modes: validator absent so incomplete plans ship
requirements.recovery: Repair loop.
requirements.observability: Run validator over released plans.

requirements.title: Plan readiness separate from money-commitment approval
requirements.accomplish: A plan can be READY for grading/owner review without any money committed; executing any spend requires an owner-set ceiling and explicit approval; approval is never released by a clock or inferred from silence; retries do not double-count commitments.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Readiness and approval are distinct states; no spend occurs without approval within ceiling; readiness does not wait on approval.
failure_modes: plan blocked waiting for spend approval so no plan exists
requirements.recovery: Hold spend; keep plan ready.
requirements.observability: Inspect state machine transitions; attempt spend without approval in a test.

requirements.title: Honest status and confidence disclosure
requirements.accomplish: The plan and the goal status state confidence, open decisive unknowns and interpretations; a goal with no plan meeting the bar reports infeasible/blocked with reason instead of presenting a weak plan as ready.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Stated confidence equals computed confidence; open unknowns listed; no 'ready' status on a plan with unresolved critical findings.
requirements.recovery: Downgrade status.
requirements.observability: Compare status to findings and computed confidence.

requirements.title: Execution result capture
requirements.accomplish: Record actual outcomes (actions taken, leads, replies, sales, cash settled, costs, dates) against each plan step and checkpoint.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each checkpoint has an actual value or an explicit 'not measured'; actuals are attributed to the step that produced them.
requirements.recovery: Reconcile from source systems.
requirements.observability: Compare checkpoint table to actuals.

requirements.title: Prediction-vs-outcome attribution
requirements.accomplish: Compare predictions with actuals, identify which assumptions or evidence were wrong, and update their status.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each significant miss is attributed to specific assumptions; those assumptions' status changes.
requirements.recovery: Re-run attribution.
requirements.observability: Inspect attribution records.

requirements.title: Learning that changes later decisions
requirements.accomplish: Store learned priors (conversion rates, lead times, payout delays, strategy-class success, research methods that worked, model quality per task) with scope, and make later discovery, economics, research and routing read them; measure that decisions changed.
requirements.correct_behaviour: A later goal's relevant computation reads the updated prior (visible in provenance) and its output differs accordingly; stale or over-broad priors are scoped.
failure_modes: prior from one geography applied everywhere
requirements.recovery: Scope and decay priors; require evidence counts.
requirements.observability: Trace later goals' reads of priors; A/B on replay.

requirements.title: Learning from reasoning failures without test-set overfit
requirements.accomplish: Classify each failed or rejected plan into the critical-mistake taxonomy, trace to requirement, and improve procedure; keep evaluation objectives out of the training/tuning loop.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each improvement targets a classified failure; acceptance objectives are never used for tuning.
requirements.recovery: Hold-out discipline; re-measure on fresh objectives.
requirements.observability: Audit tuning data against evaluation set.

requirements.title: Safe execution of external effects
requirements.accomplish: External effects (emails, payments, orders, posts) are performed exactly once per logical intent; an unknown outcome (timeout) is recorded as unknown and not auto-retried.
requirements.correct_behaviour: No duplicated effects under retry/crash; unknown outcomes surfaced.
requirements.recovery: Reconcile with provider before retry.
requirements.observability: Fault-inject during effects; count duplicates.

requirements.title: Model provider failure resilience
requirements.accomplish: Handle timeouts, rate limits, outages and degraded models with bounded retry, backoff and fallback providers without losing progress or accepting degraded output.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Provider outage delays but does not corrupt or silently truncate a goal; fallback outputs pass Q-R056.
failure_modes: outage produces empty outputs that pass as results
whole goal fails on one timeout
requirements.recovery: Retry, fallback, resume.
requirements.observability: Fault injection on model calls.

requirements.title: Research infrastructure failure handling
requirements.accomplish: When search or page fetch fails (API down, blocked, CAPTCHAs), mark the question unanswered/unresolved, try alternatives, and never record absence of results as a negative finding.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Infrastructure failures appear as failure states, not as 'no evidence exists'; decisions depending on them use Q-R026 rules.
requirements.recovery: Retry later; alternative sources; in-plan test.
requirements.observability: Simulate search outage; inspect conclusions.

requirements.title: Work queue and worker reliability
requirements.accomplish: Asynchronous workers claim work with exclusive leases, heartbeat, release or fail it; stuck items are recovered; no item is dropped; idle capacity is used while work waits.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every item terminal within bound; no double ownership; idle workers beside ready work is detected and corrected.
requirements.recovery: Lease expiry; reassignment; watchdog.
requirements.observability: Queue metrics: age, double-lease count, idle-with-backlog time.

requirements.title: Database integrity and recovery
requirements.accomplish: State writes are transactional; a database failure leaves no partial state; recovery restores consistency; the system detects and refuses to proceed on inconsistent state.
requirements.correct_behaviour: After an injected DB failure, goal model is either pre- or post-transaction, never between; derived state recomputes cleanly.
failure_modes: connection loss treated as empty data
requirements.recovery: Rollback; recompute derived state.
requirements.observability: Fault injection on DB writes; consistency checker.

requirements.title: Per-goal compute and research budget
requirements.accomplish: Bound model tokens, strong-model calls, research calls and wall time per goal, allocating by decision value; exhaustion forces a decision with disclosed uncertainty rather than an abort or silent truncation.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Spend per goal within budget; budget exhaustion produces a terminal outcome with disclosed gaps.
failure_modes: budget cut mid-step truncates outputs silently
requirements.recovery: Reallocate; decide with current evidence.
requirements.observability: Budget ledger per goal.

requirements.title: End-to-end trace for diagnosis
requirements.accomplish: Record, per goal, every faculty call: inputs (goal-model version), model and prompt, raw output, validation result, accepted output, decisions, and links between them, so any plan can be replayed and each mistake traced to its origin step.
requirements.correct_behaviour: For any plan figure or decision, the trace reaches the model call and evidence that produced it.
requirements.recovery: Instrument missing steps.
requirements.observability: Pick random plan facts; follow trace to origin.

requirements.title: Frozen, identifiable revision and reproducibility
requirements.accomplish: The code, prompts, model versions, configuration and knowledge snapshot used for acceptance are frozen under one identifier, and the whole run is attributable to it.
outputs: revision id on every goal and plan
requirements.correct_behaviour: All 30 acceptance plans carry the same revision id; no config or prompt changed during the run.
failure_modes: model provider silently changes model version
requirements.recovery: Restart evaluation on a new frozen revision.
requirements.observability: Check revision ids on all evaluated plans; diff config across run.

requirements.title: Unfamiliar, feasible objective suite
requirements.accomplish: Maintain a suite of 30 diverse objectives (amounts, windows, capitals, involvement levels, owner profiles, jurisdictions, industries) never used in development, each with independently established feasibility, plus infeasible controls outside the 30.
requirements.correct_behaviour: No suite objective (or near-duplicate) appears in development data; each has a feasibility argument by someone other than the system.
requirements.recovery: Replace leaked items.
requirements.observability: Leakage check vs development data; diversity stats.

requirements.title: Independent grading against the usable-plan rubric
requirements.accomplish: Grade each plan by a grader independent of the system (different people or model family, no access to system prompts), using the usable-plan definition and critical-mistake taxonomy, with verification of factual claims (buyers exist, fees, settlement times) and inter-grader agreement measured.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Each grade lists element verdicts and any critical mistakes with evidence; agreement between graders measured and adequate.
failure_modes: grader shares the system's blind spots
requirements.recovery: Add graders; adjudicate disagreements.
requirements.observability: Inter-rater agreement; spot-audit grades.

requirements.title: Acceptance computation
requirements.accomplish: Compute the acceptance result: at least 27 of 30 plans USABLE with zero critical mistakes, all from one frozen revision, one run per objective (no best-of-n selection unless the system itself does it within budget).
requirements.correct_behaviour: Verdict reproducible from grade records; no cherry-picked reruns; revision single.
requirements.recovery: Re-run whole suite on a new revision.
requirements.observability: Audit run log and grade records.

requirements.title: Failure classification to requirements
requirements.accomplish: Map every failed plan to critical-mistake categories and to the requirement(s) whose failure caused it, using the trace.
requirements.correct_behaviour: Every failure has at least one mapped requirement with trace evidence.
requirements.recovery: Improve trace.
requirements.observability: Inspect mapping records.
